classifications.rationale: name match "\b(http[_-]?(get|post|put|delete)|fetch|request)\b" → network/read (0.70); description match "\b(http|https|fetch|request|webhook|api[_-]?call|url|origin)\b" → network/read (0.50); schema: arg "url" is URL-shaped → network (0.40)
classifications.recommended_caveat: tool == "fetch" AND caller == "<your-caller-id>" AND arg.url == "https://<your-allowed-origin>" AND now <= @<your-cap-expiry>  // READ network; allowlist exact origins (capnagent round 05/09)
